# Mongolia

> [!summary] Data available
> Thin food coverage but decent plant data: dishes come only from knowledge bases and small recipe sets ([[RecipeDB2]] ≈60, [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 13), while [[KNApSAcK Family]] (252 records), [[CMAUP]] (95 plants) and [[NPASS]] (66 pairs) cover plants. No FCT.

## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈60 recipes in the "Chinese and Mongolian" region (samples only held). [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 13 user-tagged recipes.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 5 dishes, 1 Mongolia-specific. [[FmLAMA]]: 3 dishes (44 rows). [[World Wide Dishes]]: 1 dish.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Mongolian FCT; borrow from [[USDA FoodData Central]]. The [[Kyrgyzstan Food Composition Table]] has related pastoral foods (mare/yak milk, koumiss).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[KNApSAcK Family]]: 252 records (91 edible / 161 medicinal). [[CMAUP]]: 95 plants (93 scraped). [[NPASS]]: 66 species–compound pairs. [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 3 records.
- Compounds and health effects come only from the [[Global]] resources ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[NPASS]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No composition, QA or traditional-medicine (Mongolian medicine) data.
